items.zh: 还有明天去上海的票吗？

answers.en: Are there any tickets to Shanghai for tomorrow?
answers.zh: 明天去上海的票还有吗？

answers.en: Do you have anything left for tomorrow?
answers.note: anything left 问还剩什么，适合春运或节假日。

answers.en: What times do you have tomorrow?
answers.note: 票还有，问具体有哪几班。

answers.en: Do you have sleeper tickets?
answers.note: sleeper 是卧铺，美国火车也用这个词。

answers.en: Are there any sleepers left?
Is there a sleeper car on this train?
answers.note: 问这趟车有没有卧铺车厢。

answers.en: Are there any second-class seats left?
answers.note: 中国高铁的“二等座”直译，售票窗口通用。

answers.en: Is second class sold out?
answers.note: sold out 是卖完了，问是不是没票了。

answers.en: Do you have anything in second class?
answers.note: anything 问二等座还有没有任意班次。
answers.zh: 二等座还有别的班次吗？

answers.en: How do I buy a student ticket?
Do you offer student discounts?
answers.note: 问有没有学生优惠，不一定特指火车票。

answers.en: What do I need for a student ticket?
Do kids need ID for a ticket?
Does my son need his own ticket?
answers.note: 问孩子要不要单独买票。

answers.en: Is there a child fare?
Can I buy a ticket with my passport?
answers.note: with my passport 说清楚用什么证件。

answers.en: Do you take foreign passports?
answers.note: 问窗口收不收外国护照。

answers.en: Is my passport enough to buy a ticket?
Is there a fee to change my ticket?
How much does it cost to change?
Can I change it for free?
How much do I lose if I refund this?
answers.note: refund 是退票，lose 问会损失多少。

answers.en: What's the cancellation fee?
answers.note: cancellation fee 是退票手续费。

answers.en: Do I get a full refund?
Which stations does this train stop at?
Does it stop in Nanjing?
How many stops before Shanghai?
answers.note: 问到上海之前还有几站。

answers.en: How long does it take to the last stop?
How many hours is the ride?
When does it get in?
answers.note: get in 是到站，问几点到。

answers.en: Is there a dining car?
answers.note: dining car 是餐车，正式说法。

answers.en: Can I get food on the train?
answers.note: 问车上能不能买到吃的。

answers.en: Do they sell meals on board?

items.scene: 你在候车厅问工作人员

answers.en: Where's the ticket gate?
Which ticket gate is for my train?
answers.note: 检票口按车次分，问哪个口是自己的车。
answers.zh: 我这趟车在哪个检票口？

answers.en: Where do I scan my ticket?
answers.note: scan 是刷票，问在哪儿刷。

items.scene: 你在候车厅问工作人员

answers.en: Which platform is it?
What platform does it leave from?
Is it platform three?

items.scene: 你在候车厅问工作人员

answers.en: How do I get to the platform?
Which way to the platforms?
Do I take the escalator down?

items.scene: 你在车站大厅问工作人员

answers.en: Where's the waiting area?
answers.note: waiting area 是候车区，美国车站常用。

answers.en: Is there a waiting room?
Where do I wait for the train?

items.scene: 你抱着孩子在车站大厅问

answers.en: Is there a nursing room?
Where can I change the baby?
answers.note: 问在哪儿能给孩子换尿布。

answers.en: Do you have a family room?
answers.note: family room 是家庭卫生间，美国常见。

items.scene: 你在候车厅问工作人员

answers.en: Where's the water dispenser?
Is there hot water for tea?
Can I refill my thermos here?
answers.note: refill 是续水，thermos 是保温杯。

items.scene: 你在车站入口问工作人员

answers.en: How early should I get here for security?
How long does security take?
Do I need to arrive an hour early?

items.scene: 你在车站入口问工作人员

answers.en: Can I travel without a paper ticket?
answers.note: 问能不能不取纸质票直接进站。

answers.en: Can I just use my ID?
Do I have to print my ticket?
answers.note: print 是打印，问必须打吗。

items.zh: 身份证能直接刷进站吗？
items.scene: 你在检票口问工作人员

answers.en: Can I scan my ID to get in?
Do I need a ticket to go through?
Does my ID work at the gate?
answers.note: 问身份证在闸机能不能用。

items.zh: 我的车次在哪个候车区？
items.scene: 你在候车厅问工作人员

answers.en: Which waiting area is for my train?
answers.note: 问自己的车在哪个候车区。
answers.zh: 我这趟车在哪个候车区？

answers.en: Which waiting room is G12 in?
answers.note: 直接报车次，问在哪个候车室。

answers.en: Which section is for Shanghai trains?

items.scene: 你在候车厅问旁边的人

answers.en: What train was that announcement for?
answers.zh: 刚才广播说的是哪趟车？

answers.en: Did they just call my train?
answers.note: 问是不是叫到自己这趟。

answers.en: What did they say about the delay?
answers.note: 广播提到晚点，问具体说了什么。

answers.en: Do you have wheelchair assistance?
Can someone help my mother to the platform?
answers.note: 问能不能有人送到站台。
answers.zh: 能有人送我妈到站台吗？

answers.en: Where do I request a wheelchair?

items.scene: 你把包落在车上了，问服务台

answers.en: Is there a lost and found here?
answers.note: lost and found 是失物招领。

answers.en: I left my bag on the train. Where do I ask?
answers.note: 说清楚落在车上，方便对方查。

answers.en: Can you check if my bag was turned in?
answers.note: turn in 是上交，问有没有人交来。
answers.zh: 能查一下有没有人交来吗？

answers.en: Can I bring my dog on the train?
Are pets allowed on this train?
Does my cat need a carrier?
answers.note: carrier 是宠物箱，问要不要装笼子。

items.scene: 你在检票口问工作人员

answers.en: Am I allowed to bring a bike?
answers.note: allowed 问允不允许，比 can 更明确是规定问题。

answers.en: Do I have to fold the bike?
Is there a bike fee?
answers.note: 问自行车要不要另外收费。

answers.en: Where do I put a big suitcase?
Is there a luggage rack?
Can I leave it at the end of the car?

items.scene: 你在车站大厅问工作人员

answers.en: What time does the station close?
Is the station open all night?
When's the last train?
answers.note: 问末班车，比问关门更实用。

items.scene: 你上车后拿着票问旁边乘客

answers.en: Is this my seat?
Am I in the right seat?
Does this seat belong to me?
answers.note: 稍微正式，问这个座位是不是自己的。

answers.en: Where's the dining car?
Which way to the dining car?
How many cars down is the dining car?
What's the next stop?
Is the next stop Nanjing?
How long until the next stop?
How much longer to Shanghai?
When do we get to Shanghai?
Are we close to Shanghai?
How long does this stop last?
How many minutes here?
Can I get off for a minute?
Can I get off to buy something?
Is there time to grab food?
answers.note: grab food 是快速买点吃的。

answers.en: Will the train wait?

items.scene: 你上车后发现行李架没地方

answers.en: What if the rack is full?
Where else can I put my bag?
Can I leave it in the aisle?
answers.note: aisle 是过道，问能不能放过道。

answers.en: Is there WiFi on the train?
How do I connect to the train WiFi?
Is the WiFi free?
Could you turn down the AC?
answers.note: turn down the AC 是把空调调小。

answers.en: Can I move away from the AC?
answers.note: 问能不能换个离空调远的位置。
answers.zh: 我能换个离空调远点的座吗？

answers.en: Is it possible to raise the temperature?
answers.note: 更正式，问能不能调高温度。

answers.en: Where's the restroom?
Is there a bathroom in this car?
Which way to the restroom?
Where do I pay the fare difference?
Can I buy an upgrade on board?
answers.note: 问能不能在车上补票升座。

answers.en: Who do I ask about upgrading?

items.scene: 你上车后问旁边的乘客

answers.en: Could you help me with my bag?
Can you lift this up for me?
answers.note: lift up 是抬上去，指放行李架。

answers.en: Would you mind giving me a hand?
answers.note: give me a hand 是搭把手，很口语。

answers.en: When does the dining car open?
What time do they start serving food?
Is the dining car open now?
Can I tap my card?
answers.note: tap 是拍卡/闪付，小额支付很常用。

answers.en: Do you accept Visa?
answers.note: 直接报卡组织，问收不收。

answers.en: Is it cash only?
answers.note: cash only 是只收现金，先确认。

answers.en: How do I get out of the station?
Where's the exit?
Which exit should I use?
answers.note: 大站有多个出口，问走哪个。
